title: Singularity removal rigidity theorems for minimal hypersurfaces in manifolds with nonnegative scalar curvature
summary: We prove two "Singularity removal rigidity theorems" for minimal hypersurfaces with isolated singularities in manifolds of nonnegative scalar curvature (Theorems \ref{thm: rigidity for minimal surface} and \ref{thm: georch free of singularity}). In particular, we observe a new phenomenon that the extremal scalar curvature condition forces smoothness, which reveals a kind of positive effect of minimal hypersurface singularities in scalar curvature geometry. As an application, we obtain a direct proof of the positive mass theorem (PMT) for asymptotically flat $8$-manifolds with arbitrary ends…
